subject: Low-touch vendor onboarding request + PO-exception plan (BrightEdge Labs pilot)
messages:
From: Sara Bloom <sara@smallvendor.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick onboarding ask for BrightEdge pilot

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — BrightEdge is keen to try a small integration for a 3-month pilot. They expect very low monthly spend (~$600/month) but they prefer not to do a formal PO for small pilots. Can you confirm what information you need to get them into your system quickly? They'd like to be able to sign an MSA and start within the next 10 business days.

I've attached our vendor intake form and a short bank letter for payment terms.

Best,
Sara
VP, Partnerships
SmallVendor, Inc.
Attachments: vendor-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf), bank-letter.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: BrightEdge Labs Procurement <procurement@brightedge.com>, Sara Bloom <sara@smallvendor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick onboarding ask for BrightEdge pilot

Hi Sara / BrightEdge team,

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Quick context for procurement: BrightEdge will run a narrow pilot that we expect to bill on a monthly usage invoice. Because the monthly spend is under our PO threshold, I'm proposing we treat this as a "low-touch" vendor onboarding with a temporary PO-exception for the pilot period.

Proposal (requesting procurement + finance sign-off):
- 90-day pilot window, auto-review at day 75.
- No PO required for invoices <= $1,000/month during the pilot.
- Require completed vendor intake form + W-9 (US vendors) + bank-letter on file.
- Minimal MSA countersigned (template attached) — legal to confirm limited-scope addendum.
- Add vendor to temporary allowlist; finance to set a single invoice routing alias.

I've attached a short risk matrix that outlines criteria for low-touch vs. full onboarding. Marissa — if legal contract language is okay, can we expedite a draft MSA for Sara to share with BrightEdge? Priyom / Hannah — can procurement confirm whether we can accept the temporary no-PO route and what approvals are required?

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick onboarding ask for BrightEdge pilot

Logan — thanks for the summary and the matrix. I've reviewed the proposed thresholds. A few notes from procurement perspective:

- We can approve a temporary no-PO allowance for pilots under $1,000/month provided vendor passes the low-touch risk assessment and we have a signed MSA or signature-equivalent (DocuSign).
- Required evidence: completed intake form, tax document, banking details, and PI/DP questionnaire if the integration touches PII.
- Approvals: Procurement manager + Finance business partner must sign off. I'll need Hannah to confirm finance availability for the sign-off flow.

Action items for us:
1) I'll attach a short checklist and add the vendor to the staging allowlist once evidence is received.
2) We need to gate the temporary exception to a max of 90 days and include auto-escalation to full procurement if spend or data scope expands.

Priyom
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@smallvendor.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick onboarding ask for BrightEdge pilot

Hi Sara — great to hear BrightEdge is aligned. I pulled our standard MSA and created a 1-page SOW addendum describing the pilot's limited scope and termination rights. I'm happy to send a DocuSign if that helps move faster.

Couple things on my side:
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default. For pilots, we can accept a single invoice per month against the account alias Logan will share.
- Data handling: if the pilot touches BrightEdge customer data, we will add a short data processing addendum — Priyom, can you confirm whether the PI/DP questionnaire is needed here?

Sara — please confirm the contact who will sign on BrightEdge's side and I'll route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Quick onboarding ask for BrightEdge pilot

All — finance is OK with the temporary exception as long as:
- The $1,000/month threshold is enforced by the billing alias and automated alerts if invoices exceed 80% of threshold.
- Vendor is on the temporary allowlist and flagged in the accounting system with a special GL code.
- We receive and store the signed MSA (or DocuSign envelope ID) and intake evidence before the first invoice.

I'll set a calendar reminder for day 75 review and will coordinate the sign-off (Finance BP + Procurement manager). Priyom — please send the staging allowlist link once vendor evidence is uploaded.

Hannah Schmitt
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks everyone — Sara, next steps to get you live:
1) Fill out the vendor-intake-form.pdf and return to procurement@redwoodinference.com.
2) Sign the attached MSA via DocuSign (link below). Marissa will send the envelope shortly.
3) Priyom will add you to the staging allowlist and notify accounting.
4) Finance will enable the billing alias and threshold alerts; we will auto-escalate to full procurement if invoices exceed $800/month before the 90-day review.

If all good, I'll mark the pilot start for May 3 and send a short mutual action plan. Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Best —
Logan
